jobs.description:
My client is looking for a Business Consultant POS Systems to support and improve the technology behind 400+ Point-of-Sale terminals across 40 stores in Belgium and the Netherlands. This role is central to ensuring seamless store operations while contributing to major transformation projects in an evolving omnichannel retail environment.

As part of a close-knit international team, you will act as the link between business stakeholders, IT teams and external vendors. You will ensure the stability and evolution of the POS landscape while helping prepare the organisation for future challenges, including the replacement of its current POS platform. 

• Ensure the availability and performance of POS systems across all stores.
• Manage incidents and provide second and third-line support.
• Gather business requirements and translate them into practical solutions.
• Coordinate with software vendors and implementation partners.
• Support the rollout of new functionalities such as self-checkout, self-scan and advanced pricing and promotional features.
• Contribute to projects focused on modernising store operations and enhancing the customer experience.
• Work closely with SAP teams to ensure seamless integration between retail systems.
• Support omnichannel initiatives and the growing importance of eCommerce within the organisation.
• Play an active role in the future replacement of the current POS solution.

You understand retail operations and enjoy working in a business-facing IT role where you can combine analysis, process improvement and technology. You may come from a background such as: Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, Application Manager, Retail System Specialist, POS Consultant, Store Operation IT Specialist.

• Dutch is mandatory, Professional level of English, French is a strong plus.
• Experience in a retail environment.
• Understanding of store operations and retail business processes.
• Experience with POS systems is highly desirable.
• Ability to translate business needs into effective IT solutions.
• Experience working with vendors and multiple stakeholders.
• SAP knowledge is considered an advantage.

This Belgian manufacturer of dry powder mixtures for the construction industry (mortars, adhesives, plasters, etc.), located in the Port of Antwerp, is looking to strengthen its current team with a motivated OPERATOR.

As an OPERATOR, you will be responsible for all operational tasks required during your shift for production and loading activities. You will play a crucial role in the production process and will be widely deployable across various production lines, from mixing processes to bagging.

Your responsibilities as an OPERATOR* will include:

• Preparing, weighing and accurately dosing raw materials and additives for mixing processes, particularly liquids.
• Monitoring and operating mixing and filling machines, such as dissolvers, mixing tanks and filling equipment.
• Operating, converting and setting up bagging machines.
• Setting up and loading packaging materials (e.g. film) onto the machines.
• Carrying out process checks and visual inspections of the finished product, such as checking viscosity and colour consistency.
• Replacing simple mechanical components on the production lines.
• Processing residual product and cleaning the factory, including cleaning mixing equipment and pipelines.
• Assisting drivers during loading operations.
• Carrying out internal transport and logistical activities using a forklift and/or reach truck.

REF:MEC

Experience & Profile

• You have proven relevant work experience as an OPERATOR in a production environment.
• Experience with mixing, dispersing or filling liquids, or operating bagging and packaging machines, is preferred.
• A valid forklift and/or reach truck certificate is a major advantage.
• You are familiar with terminology and techniques used in the mixing industry, such as batch production, dosing and basic quality control
• You have a technical aptitude and a strong problem-solving mindset.
• You are communicative and have a good command of Dutch or English

CE Driver Wanted in the Port of Antwerp

For a logistics company located in the Port of Antwerp, we are looking for an experienced and motivated CE Driver.

As a driver, you will be responsible for the safe and timely transport of bulk goods and containers to and from various locations in and around the port. You will join a professional transport environment where safety, punctuality and clear communication are key.

What will you do?

• You are responsible for container transport to and from the Port of Antwerp.
• You collect containers from terminals and deliver them to customers.
• You carry out national transport, mainly within Belgium and the surrounding region.
• You check the load and ensure that containers are properly and safely secured.
• You ensure the correct handling of transport documents.
• You stay in contact with the planning department and communicate any problems or delays.
• You comply with the applicable safety regulations in the port.
• You are responsible for the proper inspection and care of your truck and trailer.
You will mainly work from the Port of Antwerp and carry out predominantly national and regional routes.

Interested?

Apply today and discover whether this position as a CE Driver in the Port of Antwerp is the right opportunity for you!

REF: MEC

• You have a valid CE driving licence and Code 95
• Previous experience with container transport is preferred.
• Experience driving in the Port of Antwerp is a strong advantage.
• An  ADR certificate is a strong advantage.
• You are a safe and responsible driver.
• You are punctual, reliable and customer-oriented.
• You can work independently, while communicating smoothly with the planning department.
• You are flexible and have no problem with the dynamic nature of port and transport work.
• You have a sufficient level of  English to communicate smoothly.

Our client, located in the Mechelen region, specializes in the production and printing of paper, cardboard and polyethylene packaging.

We are looking for a motivated person to join the team. You will be responsible for producing and packaging various types of paper and cardboard packaging for the food industry.

• You produce and package various types of paper and cardboard packaging for the food industry.
• You set up the machine according to the packaging to be produced.
• You are responsible for your machine, check the settings and make adjustments when necessary.
• You keep track of production data and follow up on production orders. 
• You work closely with the technical team regarding planning, deviations and maintenance.
• You carry out quality checks on the products to detect any deviations.
• You are a reliable member of a close-knit team and contribute to ensuring production continuity.

REF: MEC

• You have at least a few years of experience as a Technical Line Operator
• You have experience working with mechanical production machinery
• You have a stable employment history
• You have a very good knowledge of Dutch, French or English.

Production Operator with Technical Insight Wanted in Kampenhout!

Do you have experience in a production environment and enjoy taking responsibility?

This company, located in Kampenhout, is a leading producer and supplier of professional fluids for the automotive and industrial sectors.

From this site, they manufacture a wide range of maintenance, cleaning, and consumable products for workshops and garages.

To strengthen their team, they are looking for a Production Operator with technical insight who enjoys working independently and taking responsibility for an entire production line.

Your Challenge

As a Production Operator, you will be responsible for correctly setting up, converting, starting, and operating the production line.

You will ensure that every product is manufactured and filled according to the required specifications.

Your Responsibilities

Production Line Changeovers

• Adjusting and converting the production line according to technical specifications.
• Changing packaging materials, caps, labels, and boxes.
• Setting up printing information on bottles, cans, and boxes.
• Selecting the correct production programs and parameters.
• Starting up the production line.

Filling and Production

• Interpreting and following technical specifications and work instructions.
• Checking materials at the production line.
• Replenishing labels, packaging materials, and other production supplies.
• Manually packing finished products into boxes.
• Performing quality checks on weight, dosage, and product finish.
• Adjusting and fine-tuning machine settings when necessary.
• Monitoring the supply and flow of liquids throughout the process.
• Connecting new tanks to the production system.

Technical Follow-Up

• Detecting malfunctions and assisting in resolving them together with the technician.
• Reporting accurately to the Production Manager.
• Ensuring quality, safety, and efficiency throughout the production process.

REF:MEC1

• You have experience working on a production line.
• You work in a highly responsible and detail-oriented manner, with a strong focus on quality and safety.
• You are organized and tidy; you remove production waste and clean your workstation before handing it over to colleagues on the next shift.
• You are hands-on and capable of lifting and handling heavy objects with ease.
• You are eager to learn and support your colleagues; a technical background or education in mechanics or electrical/electronics engineering is a strong advantage, whether completed or not.
• You are dynamic and able to perform well under pressure.
• You are flexible and willing to work in different shifts (6:00 AM – 2:00 PM / 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM) and/or in the day shift (8:00 AM – 4:00 PM), depending on production needs. The same flexibility applies to overtime.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French, or English.

jobs.occupation: Student Kitchen helper Bier Central Mechelen / Antwerpen
jobs.description:
At Bier Central, it’s all about beer, hungry bellies, and a kitchen running at full speed. During peak hours, the orders roll merrily out of the printer. We call that “a lively rush”; you’ll soon just call it a normal Tuesday night.
 

For
 Bier Central in Mechelen and Antwerp, we’re looking for students/flexi's who are passionate about cooking and aren’t afraid of a fast-paced environment.
 

What will you be doing?
 
 

• You’ll start on the cold side: preparing salads and side dishes, doing mise en place, and getting everything ready so the rest of the team can build on your work.
 

• Then you’ll move on to the hot side, where you’ll learn, among other things, how to cook meat and fish.
 

• Eventually, you’ll be a full-fledged member of our kitchen team—from vegetable specialist to master cook—and we’ll take it step by step. 

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

Motivated student/flexi's with a passion for cooking. 
Professional experience is a plus, but certainly not a requirement.
  

•  

People who enjoy working hard and are open to learning new things
  

•  

Preferably fluent in English. Other languages are a plus.
  

•  

People who are available during the Christmas holidays. That’s our busiest—but also our most fun—time of the year. Can’t work every day? No problem, but we’d love to see you for a few shifts a week.

As a future butcher / deboner of pork meat, you will work on different lines with tasks such as cutting shoulders, bellies, and ribs. 

Experience is an asset, but motivated newcomers are welcome. 

Thanks to the Butchers Academy, you will receive comprehensive training, followed by a permanent contract and annual evaluations offering opportunities for advancement.

We are looking for ambitious and eager-to-learn individuals who can start early (start at 4.55 AM) and are flexible in their schedules depending on the season. 

You should be comfortable working in a cold environment and have an affinity for the food industry (pork meat), along with the associated quality and hygiene standards. 

You must be physically capable of standing and working all day and place importance on workplace safety. 

Language is not a barrier; everyone has equal opportunities, whether you speak English, French, or Dutch.

We're looking for a Logistics Coordinator. 

In this role you will be responsible for handling laboratory supplies, study materials, medical devices and drug products, used in clinical trials.

Tasks:

• Manage returned materials and maintain inventory records from clinical sites
• Coordinate logistics activities for clinical studies
• Support purchasing activities when required
• Ensure compliance with company procedures and regulatory requirements
• Support the daily operations of the Central Laboratory supply team

A strong knowledge (written and spoken) in English is required, knowledge in another language is a big asset. Logistics tasks such as shipping, calling, mailing, checking in on stock, are interesting to you. A detail and client oriented mentality is needed. You ensure a day to day fluency in logistics and supply chain.

As Warehouse Operator, you will execute in an accurate manner tasks concerning both the physical handling and administration aspect of goods that are received, stocked, delivered to internal customers and shipped to external contacts.

The assignment

• Make sure that goods are stored and registered in the appropriate location

• Stock counts

• Check stock of standard goods in the cleanroom and ensure sufficient and timely supply within shelf life and register accordingly

• Deliver goods to cleanroom upon request of internal customers and register accordingly

• Receive goods from internal customers, pack, label and ship to external location taking into account applicable legislation

• You work efficiently, accurately and neatly and have an eye for safety.

• You are energetic, not afraid of physical work and have a great sense of responsibility.

• Your team spirit guarantees a flexible working arrangement.

• You speak fluent Dutch and have a good knowledge of English.

• A certificate for operation of an electric stacker and forklift driving license is a plus.

• You preferably have several years of experience in administrative processing, experience with SAP is a plus.

In the cutting room, where they process pork from farms within a 30 km radius, you’ll be responsible for precise cutting and ensuring top-quality products.

Your tasks include cutting various pork parts such as:   

•  Shoulders

• Bellies

• Ribs  

• And more!

You’ll work with precision and care, following strict hygiene and animal welfare standards, using the right tools for the job.

 

• Motivated & eager to learn – ambition is key!

• Flexible with work hours – shifts start at 3:25 AM, 4:55 AM, or 9 AM

Do you have experience in car body repair and enjoy working on vehicles? Join a company that is one of the world's leading providers of cargo handling and storage services in ports.

You'll prepare, repair and finish vehicle bodywork while working daytime hours, earning from €17.14 gross per hour, with meal vouchers worth €8.70 and internal training.

As a car body repair worker, you'll carry out various preparation and finishing tasks to ensure vehicles are ready for the next stage.

 
• 
Prepare vehicle surfaces by sanding, degreasing and applying primer.

 
• 
Mask vehicles accurately using regular and heat-resistant masking tape.

 
• 
Polish and finish bodywork to achieve a high-quality final result.

 
• 
Dismantle and reassemble vehicle parts as required.

 
• 
Move vehicles to the correct designated zones.

 
• 
You have previous experience in car body repair.

 
• 
You hold a valid category B driving licence.

 
• 
You can communicate in English.

 
• 
You work together with colleagues as part of a team.

Our client is a wholesale company based in Sint-Katelijne-Waver, specialized in the distribution of fresh fruit and vegetables in Belgium and the Netherlands.

For decades, this wholesale organization has been active in the fresh produce sector, using its knowledge and experience every day to search for opportunities, innovations, and top-quality products.

They can rightfully call themselves a leading player in the distribution, import, and export of fruit and vegetables.

Would you like to be part of their team?

Our client is looking for a motivated CE truck driver!

• Holder of a CE driving license with valid Code 95.
• Hard worker, committed to your job, with respect for customers, colleagues, and entrusted equipment.
• Not afraid of loading and unloading yourself.
• You will be the company’s calling card.
Does this sound like the right opportunity for you?

Send us your CV today, and we’ll get to work for you!

REF:MEC

• CE driving license.
• Code 95.
• Initial experience in distribution is an asset.
• Willing to work occasionally on Saturdays.
• Flexible, customer-oriented, and punctual.
• Flexible availability for both day and night shifts (both are required).
• Good knowledge of Dutch or French and English (understanding, writing, and speaking).

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
Are you an experienced reach truck driver looking for a job in Roeselare? You'll mainly operate a reach truck in a frozen food warehouse, handling incoming and outgoing goods and keeping stock organised.

You'll start in the dayshift from 08:00 to 16:30, operate a closed reach truck in a warehouse at -18°C, and receive suitable protective clothing. After a successful interim period, there's a possibility of a permanent contract.

As a reach truck driver, you'll help ensure that goods are stored correctly and ready for shipment.

 
• 
Check incoming and outgoing goods to ensure everything is in order.

 
• 
Store incoming products in the correct warehouse locations.

 
• 
Prepare outgoing goods for loading onto trucks.

 
• 
Scan products into the warehouse system once they are in the correct location.

 
• 
Mainly operate a reach truck, occasionally using a forklift or pallet truck when needed.

 
• 
You hold a valid reach truck certificate.

 
• 
You already have experience operating a reach truck and can stack goods at heights of up to 10 metres.

 
• 
You can communicate fluently in Dutch, English or French.

 
• 
Working in the dayshift from 08:00 to 16:30 suits you. Your working hours may be discussed over time.

 
• 
You can work in a frozen warehouse at -18°C, using a closed reach truck and suitable protective clothing.

For our client in Gijzegem, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician m/f/x to work in a 2-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM). Are you technically skilled, eager to learn, and ready to roll up your sleeves? Then you might be the colleague we are looking for!
 

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring the optimal operation of our machinery and production equipment. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
 

In addition, you will contribute to technical improvements and small-scale projects aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of our installations. A positive attitude and willingness to continuously develop your skills are just as important as your technical knowledge. Experience with PLC systems is a plus, and further training will be provided internally.
 

Your Responsibilities
 

 
• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
 
• Quickly and efficiently diagnose and resolve faults in electrical, electronic, hydraulic, and mechanical systems.
 
• Independently execute small technical improvement projects.
 
• Participate actively in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance machine performance and reliability.
 
• Help maintain a safe working environment and comply with environmental regulations.
 
• Contribute to housekeeping and cleanliness standards within the workshop and production areas. 

 
• You have a technical education (A2 level, Associate Degree, or Bachelor's degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation, or equivalent through experience).
 
• Knowledge of injection molding machines is an advantage.
 
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is a plus; additional training can be provided internally.
 
• You have experience maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and equipment.
 
• Experience in a manufacturing environment and with preventive maintenance is a strong asset.
 
• You have a good command of Dutch.
 
• You can understand technical manuals and documentation in English and/or German.
 
• You have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
 
• You can efficiently solve electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.
 
• You take a proactive approach and contribute ideas to prevent future breakdowns.
 
• You are able to work independently on maintenance and repair activities.
 
• You are service-minded and enjoy collaborating with colleagues across different departments.
 
• You communicate clearly about technical issues and solutions.
 
• You work closely with production teams to minimize downtime.

Scope
 

The project leader’s role is to technically manage IC design and supply projects to ensure technical quality and timely delivery. 
 

Responsibilities
 

Be the technical lead for an entire project, taking into account customer milestones and making sure technical specifications and quality standards are met:
 
 

• Daily follow-up of all project team members: designers, layouters, testers 

• Support and coach team members with technical expertise and strong problem solving skills 

• Maintain detailed overview and knowledge of the complete mixed-signal development 

• Organize, lead, attend internal status meetings to keep abreast about the project progress 

• Be the technical point of contact for the customer 

• Write the IC design specification and ensure a timely update in case of customer change requests 

• Ensure compliance with all safety and quality standards 

• Closely work together with and report potential problems on time to the Project Manager  
  
 

Competences
 
 

• You are a dynamic and highly motivated engineer in micro-electronics 

• You have at least 5 years of relevant industrial work experience 

• You are an experienced user of the mixed-signal flow of Cadence and/or Synopsys and Matlab 

• You have strong communication and reporting skills, also in English 

• You demonstrate excellent analytical and problem solving skills

jobs.occupation: Technician in day shift - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium in the area of Oostkamp-Bruges? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the area of Oostkamp or Bruges
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not obligated, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC... The company can teach you these on the job.
